read_coverage.response_schema: Read in full; supplied file is a response specimen, not a formal JSON Schema with enums. All supplied fields completed; unknown used for unverified identity/independence.
read_coverage.identifiers: Read in full and copied exact binding fields.
read_coverage.production_report: File hash/length verified only; content not relied on scientifically.
